votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve Ordinance No. 2025-002 amending an approved PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) for two new commercial buildings on 2.15 acres in the Atkinville Interchange Area Master Plan generally located on the east side of Pioneer Road north of Sun River Parkway and north of Chevron and Terribles.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.section: APPOINTMENT OF THE INTERIM ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES DIRECTOR
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to appoint Robert Myers as the Interim Administrative Services Director.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2025-003 amending the city zoning map by changing the zone from A-1 (Agricultural, 40,000 sq ft minimum lot size) to OS (Open Space) on approximately 0.56 acres generally located near the St. George/Washington border near the Paseo Development.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve Ordinance No. 2025- 004 amending a Development agreement affecting approximately 5.03 acres located south of the existing southern terminus of Gap Canyon Parkway at the southern boundary of PA-2 in the Divario development, with the condition that they will work with staff to define the 5.03 acres and follow all terms of the development agreement to mitigate the disturbance upon completion of the work.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to continue this item until there is a full Council, possibly the next meeting.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve Resolution 2025- 001R to approve an Incentive Agreement between the City of St. George and Costco Wholesale Corporation, and to authorize the Mayor to sign the Incentive Agreement once it is finalized.
A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to adjourn to a closed meeting to discuss litigation and professional competence of an individual.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
